brief_rationale: The doctor correctly identified postpartum headache with gestational hypertension/preeclampsia risk as an emergency, immediately recommended ER/120, conducted comprehensive red flag screening, and provided clear action thresholds throughout. All 8 responsibility chain items are met without error. Multiple high-order points are completed: HO1 (communication adapted to anxious family), HO2 (executable family division plan), HO3 (discovered key hidden facts), and HO4 (safe bounded closure with teach-back). This trajectory demonstrates excellent medical safety recognition, clinical reasoning, and real-world adaptation.
